command: set -eu; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | grep -m1 -E 'versionName=|versionCode='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | grep -F pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
